headline: Australian Dollar Drops as Weak October Jobs Data Drives Rate Cut Bets
summary: The Australian dollar declined and Australian government bond yields fell to three-month lows after October employment data showed a second consecutive monthly job loss, increasing expectations of interest rate cuts in 2027.
why: Reserve Bank of Australia policy decisions heavily rely on domestic labor market conditions to gauge core inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Australian Dollar
impacts.why: Weaker-than-expected employment data fueled market bets on monetary policy easing by the RBA.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Contracting employment figures pushed investors to price in early monetary policy easing.
